neighbours.label: trust / confidence / hope as a noun of belief in someone or something
fire: The program is built on a foundation of trust between teachers and parents.
The coach gave the young players the confidence they needed.
Despite the setbacks, she never gave up hope for a cure.
Good leaders earn the trust of the people they serve.
Investors lost confidence in the bank after the scandal.
The letter gave the prisoners new hope of release.
Mutual trust is essential in any long friendship.
The speech restored public confidence in the government.
